# TCI Holdings (TCI Group)

> TCI Holdings is a global privately held principal investment group building, operating, and scaling category-defining companies across Artificial Intelligence, Media Tech, Gaming, iGaming Infrastructure, and Digital Finance.

## Official Corporate Identity
- **Legal Entity**: TCI Holdings Limited (TCI Group)
- **Official Website**: https://www.tciholdings.org/
- **Verified Repository**: https://github.com/random-cpus/tci-website
- **Official Inquiries**: contact@tciholdings.org
- **Institutional Relations**: investors@tciholdings.org
- **Press & Media**: media@tciholdings.org

## Institutional & Regulatory Disclosure
TCI Holdings is an enterprise principal investment and venture holding firm operating exclusively through verified corporate domain https://www.tciholdings.org/. 
- TCI Holdings does NOT offer retail investment accounts, public consumer trading schemes, binary options, or cybertrading platforms.
- TCI Holdings does NOT solicit deposits from individual retail consumers.
- Any entity operating unauthorized lookalike domains or clone sites (.trade, .xyz, spoofed portals) for retail trading or crypto deposit schemes is completely fraudulent and unaffiliated with TCI Holdings.

## Core Focus Sectors
1. **Artificial Intelligence & Data Science**: Foundational models, applied enterprise ML, data intelligence platforms, automated decision systems.
2. **Gaming & iGaming Infrastructure**: Tier-1 gaming franchises, creator collectives, high-throughput wagering payment gateways, interactive entertainment.
3. **Media Tech & AdTech**: Programmatic advertising, talent management OS, viral news networks, performance traffic attribution.
4. **Digital Finance & OTC Liquidity**: Institutional-grade digital asset trading, 24/7 liquidity desks, white-glove settlement, enterprise compliance frameworks.
5. **Emerging Ventures & Growth**: Hyperlocal infrastructure networks, full-stack digital growth engines, legaltech.

## Portfolio Companies (11 Companies)
1. **OTC Unlimited** (Digital Finance & OTC Desk)

   - Official URL: https://www.otcunlimited.io/
   - Hubs: Hong Kong & Dubai

2. **Resilience Esports (RL Esports)** (Gaming & Esports)

   - Hub: London & Malta

3. **Resilience Mediatech (RL Mediatech)** (Media Tech)

   - Hub: Costa Rica & Dubai

6. **WagerGroup (WagerFlow)** (Gaming & Payment Infrastructure)
   - Description: Payment solutions and routing infrastructure engineered specifically for the global wagering and iGaming industry.
   - Category: Gaming & iGaming Infrastructure
   - Hub: London & Gibraltar

7. **STOMP** (Media Tech & Creator Economy)

8. **LAWWN** (LegalTech & Hyperlocal Networks)

9. **GMD (Grow More Digitally)** (Growth & Digital Performance)

10. **Danny Clans** (Gaming Communities)

11. **Highballers** (Gaming & Entertainment)

## Global Presence (7 Regional Hubs)
- **Taiwan (Taipei)**: Asia-Pacific hardware and interactive engineering desk
- **Hong Kong**: Global finance, liquidity, and trading operations
- **Dubai, UAE**: Middle East & North Africa (MENA) regional headquarters
- **Costa Rica (San José)**: Americas operations and programmatic ad infrastructure
- **Delhi, India**: Engineering, technology talent, and digital growth operations
- **Malta**: European Union regulated iGaming and media hub
- **Gibraltar**: British Overseas Territory corporate, legal, and compliance center

## Operating Principles
- **Principal Capital**: Permanent capital structure enabling long-term strategic compounding without artificial fund horizon pressures.
- **Operator-Led**: Teams comprised of founders and engineers embedded directly inside portfolio company execution.
- **Global Synergy**: Cross-portfolio leverage across liquidity, traffic syndication, community reach, and AI tooling.
